tips.text: Bring Hildryn with Blazing Pillage; stand on the excavator and spam Pillage.
Bring Octavia when soloing; Mallet reflects damage at any enemy level and invisibility keeps her alive.
Bring Lavos with Valence Formation and the Cedo; it keeps its innate Condition Overload unmodded.
Wisp, Garuda, Gyre with augments and Nova with Null Star augments also work, as do Wukong for Defense and Limbo for Excavation.
Take battery weapons, innate Toxin to bypass Corpus shields, Cerata, Xoris, Arca Plasmor or Tenet weapons for base damage.
In Survival, break every container and use life support capsules early; running dry near the end is the usual fail.
In Excavation, run one excavator at a time, bank its Cryotic, then call the next; losing one loses nothing.
Expect Nullifier stacks in Excavation past 600 Cryotic and in the last Defense waves.
Check the Steel Path toggle before launching; with it on you get level 125 enemies and no mods.
Split the three Locators across a premade squad; only the host needs one, every member gets the part, and each pays 25 Vitus.
Farm the Vitus and the Plains materials before the missions, then run all three in one sitting.
Catch the 15 Murkray first; their Fish Oil plus the Traloks covers most of the Systems.
Check the valley right of Cetus for a Condroc group; kill them, leave, come back.
Players split on this farm: most call it the worst frame farm, others like it because nothing is RNG.
Expect about an hour for all three missions with the right frame.
